latestVersion.changelog:
Cost Watchdog v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Tracks real-time LLM spending across 2600+ models and 30+ providers, enforcing budget ceilings to prevent runaway costs.
- Detects runaway agent loops and unbounded API calls with AST-based code auditing.
- Supports live model pricing, usage tracking, and budget enforcement via CLI and SDK wrappers.
- Aggregates and reports spend by session, time window, and top models; provides alerts for silent errors and budgeting breaches.
- Offers multi-layer detection of active models and robust offline/static fallbacks for pricing.
- Includes unified CLI with commands for session tracking, auditing, pricing, alternatives, reporting, error review, and more.
